name: NEWCOWF World Title
epitaph: The federation's top singles championship, first won by Stone Cold Steve Austin over The Giant in a tournament final at the promotion's Tournament Finals, and still billed as his through the federation's last surviving records.

name: NEWCOWF TV Title
epitaph: First won by Ric Flair over Ahmed Johnson in a tournament final at the promotion's Tournament Finals; a later, uncollected card already bills a different champion.

name: NEWCOWF Tag Team Title
epitaph: First won by the debuting Eliminators, John Kronus and Perry Saturn, over Doug Furnas and Philip LaFon in a tournament final at the promotion's Tournament Finals; a later, uncollected card already bills different champions.
